summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on PR #434 exact head 4c73ae7bd82fb7969824bd2cdbfa49346b2dc482: generation-2 correctly guards typed REVIEW_RESULT.verdict before set membership, but validate_worker still performs WORKER_STATUSES set membership before proving status is a string, so unhashable JSON [] or {} worker statuses escape as raw TypeError instead of controlled fail-closed ControlError.
evidence: Exact-head tools/swarm/swarmctl.py binds verdict and checks isinstance(verdict, str) before REVIEW_VERDICTS membership, so the predecessor #428 verdict blocker is correctly repaired.

The same exact head validate_worker() still evaluates if obj["status"] not in WORKER_STATUSES with no preceding isinstance(status, str) guard. WORKER_STATUSES is a Python set, so JSON array/object statuses are unhashable and raise TypeError rather than ControlError.
Exact-head tools/swarm/test_swarmctl.py WorkerAndReviewSchemaCompatibilityTests covers ACTIVE/CLAIMING/DONE and unknown string FINISHED, but no non-string/unhashable worker status.

Exact-head tools/swarm/test_swarmctl_hardening.py WorkerReviewContractHardeningRegressionTests likewise covers aliases and FINISHED only; its new []/{} regression is verdict-specific and does not exercise worker status.

This is directly within the lane objective/acceptance: worker schema typing must remain strict and genuinely unknown statuses must fail closed while finite historical aliases remain compatibility-only.

Canonical CI and engine-tests reported green on the exact candidate head, demonstrating the current suite does not cover this malformed worker-status shape. pr-ownership remains separately fail-closed on the live legacy dependency-shape defect and was not bypassed.
GitHub formal REQUEST_CHANGES returned 422 because the authenticated repository identity is also the PR author; COMMENT review 4915685995 records the same independent-worker blocking verdict.

metadata.requiredRepair: Require worker status to be a string before WORKER_STATUSES membership and add []/{} status regressions asserting controlled ControlError rejection. Preserve finite compatibility aliases and ownership fencing.
